underlying_issue: F_ADDFILESIGS_RETURN needs coverage registration without Apple-platform-only identity requirement. Swift Open Source Developer ID leaf has critical Apple OID 1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13 with DER NULL; generic OpenSSL rejects this until the exact recognized marker is handled.
platform_policy: Apple root, fixed Software Signing leaf marker and intermediate, CMS and page/special-slot hashes.
embedded_policy: Apple-rooted code-signing CMS with explicitly understood Developer ID marker, or ad-hoc CD with actual page/special-slot hashes. Neither yields platform identity.
